solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Habitually drink tea, mostly outside work

indicators.note: outside tells us the shortened tea sits round the two letters for work
mostly means all but the last letter of the word tea is kept

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: A description of someone who sips tea all day except when they are at their job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims tea to TE, and 'outside' wraps TE round OP.
explanation.definitionFit: To tope is an old verb for drinking alcohol heavily and as a matter of habit.

clue.text: Irritating irregular rise in volume

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the big book

parts.note: a tome is a large book or volume

indicators.note: irregular means not in proper order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An annoying uneven surge in sound level.
explanation.walkthrough: 'irregular' shuffles the given word to IRES, and 'in' places it within the book. Volume suggests loudness but means a book.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tiresome is tedious and annoying, so irritating.

clue.text: Noble needs to practise guarding king in church

indicators.note: guarding means surrounding protectively, so the practice word goes round the rest

parts.note: to ply a trade is to practise it
R is Rex, Latin for king
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: An aristocrat must work at protecting the monarch in church.
explanation.definitionFit: Princely means befitting a prince, so grand, regal or noble.

clue.text: Attainable diamonds regularly found here

definitions.meaning: an idiom for likely or possible
diamonds are a suit, so they appear on playing cards

explanation.surface: A jeweller's hint about where gems can easily be obtained.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes diamonds as the card suit, not gems.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcome that is on the cards is likely enough to be within reach, hence achievable.

clue.text: Tend to run up banks of Seine

indicators.note: up in a down clue means read from bottom to top, so the word run backwards
banks of means the edges, the first and last letters of Seine

explanation.surface: A tip to jog upstream along the riverbanks in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: To nurse a patient is to look after or tend them.

clue.text: Servant to take in nuts I'll crack

parts.note: to house someone is to take them in

indicators.note: crack means break into, so the letter breaks into the word for crazy

parts.note: nuts means mad
I'll is I will: the letter I does the cracking

explanation.surface: A maid who shelters people while shelling nuts.
explanation.definitionFit: A housemaid is a female domestic servant who cleans a house.

clue.text: Top eastern state bounded by waterway where craft launched

parts.note: a cap is a lid or top

indicators.note: bounded by means enclosed, so the state word sits within the waterway

parts.note: a canal is a man-made waterway
to aver is to state firmly

explanation.surface: A leading eastern American state hemmed in by a river, where boats set off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a US state; it is the verb meaning declare.
explanation.definitionFit: Cape Canaveral in Florida is the site from which NASA spacecraft are launched.

clue.text: Enthusiastic band of artists?

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a member of the Royal Academy of Arts
a ring is a band, as worn on a finger

explanation.surface: A group of painters who are full of eagerness.
explanation.definitionFit: Raring to go means eager, so enthusiastic.

clue.text: Waterlogged lair beneath turf

indicators.note: beneath puts the lair under the turf in this down entry

parts.note: a sod is a piece of turf
a den is an animal's lair

explanation.surface: An animal's burrow under the grass is soaked through.
explanation.definitionFit: Sodden means soaked or saturated with water.

clue.text: Drivers, one prevaricating about vehicle on track

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the joined letters are read backwards

parts.note: the RAC is the Royal Automobile Club, a British motoring organisation for drivers
someone who prevaricates tells lies, so a liar

explanation.surface: Motorists and a dishonest person argue over some kind of vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A railcar is a self-propelled passenger carriage that runs on railway lines.

clue.text: What reviewer usually offers maybe beyond which reflection less than total

definitions.meaning: a critic gives a critical slant

definitions.text: beyond which reflection less than total
definitions.meaning: in optics the ... is the limit at which light stops passing through and is totally reflected

explanation.surface: A reviewer's typical take, and a point in physics about light.
explanation.definitionFit: In optics the critical angle is the incidence angle marking the threshold of total internal reflection.

clue.text: Posh politician one socialist judged

parts.note: U stands for upper-class, an old label for posh usage
MP is a Member of Parliament
the Roman numeral for one is I
a red is a left-winger or socialist

explanation.surface: A snobbish left-wing member of parliament passed judgement.
explanation.definitionFit: To umpire is to referee a contest, so umpired means acted as judge.

clue.text: Profanity from guru admitting constant anger

indicators.note: admitting means letting something in, so the wise man surrounds the other letters

parts.note: a guru is a wise teacher, a sage
C is the usual symbol for a constant, as for the speed of light
to rile someone is to anger them

explanation.surface: A spiritual teacher who loses his temper swears out loud.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacrilege is the violation of something sacred, the same disrespect for holy things as profanity.

clue.text: Aid when strolling round love boat

indicators.note: round says the walking aid goes round the letter for love

parts.note: a cane is a walking stick
love is nil in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A romantic stroll in which a walking stick goes round a love boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A canoe is a light narrow boat paddled by hand.

clue.text: Liquid lunch? Ugly lawman tipsy with it

indicators.note: tipsy means drunk and unsteady, so the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: An unattractive police officer who drinks at lunch is merry with it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Liquid lunch' usually means a boozy one; here it is a soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Mulligatawny is a spicy Anglo-Indian soup, a meal that is literally liquid.

clue.text: Brief relations ceased, not unexpectedly

indicators.note: unexpectedly suggests things happening out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A short-lived affair ended, as everyone saw coming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relations' looks like a love affair; here it means tellings.
explanation.definitionFit: Anecdotes are short accounts, and a relation is an old word for a story told.

clue.text: Expecting what's required for defence in test

indicators.note: only the letters needed are taken, so the answer is lifted from inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A pregnant woman's needs in a military exam.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run through defENCE IN TEst. Enceinte is also a fortified wall, so 'what's required for defence' doubles as a second definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Enceinte is a French-derived word meaning pregnant.

clue.text: Young achievers, having defect, quietly coming in second

indicators.note: coming in means entering, so these letters go inside the word for second

parts.note: to back someone is to second or support them
to rat is to desert or defect
p is piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: Successful youngsters with a flaw quietly take second place.
explanation.definitionFit: The Brat Pack were a group of young 1980s Hollywood stars, hence successful youngsters.

clue.text: Searcher wielding rod more beatific after drink

indicators.note: after places the beatific word behind the drink in the answer

parts.note: water is a drink
divine means heavenly, so more beatific is diviner

explanation.surface: A holier-than-thou figure with a stick appears once a drink is taken.
explanation.definitionFit: A water diviner walks with a forked dowsing rod looking for underground water.

clue.text: Finishes milk drink

parts.note: to milk something is to exploit it, to use it
to sup is to drink in sips

explanation.surface: Getting through the last of the milk and having a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To use up is to consume entirely, so finish.

clue.text: Quick expulsion of unknown European, first seen at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: Z is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A mysterious European is first spotted and swiftly thrown off a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A sneeze is a sudden involuntary burst of air from the nose.

clue.text: Nitrogen close to ocean absorbed by marine plant

indicators.note: absorbed by means taken inside, so these letters sit within the marine word

parts.note: marine relates to the sea
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

indicators.note: close to means the end letter of the word ocean

explanation.surface: A seaweed takes up nitrogen near the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: Senna is a cassia shrub whose pods give a well-known laxative.

clue.text: Seemingly take the excitement out of stay

definitions.text: Seemingly take the excitement out of
definitions.meaning: read as DE- plus ferment, it looks like removing the agitation
a stay is a postponement, as a stay of execution

explanation.surface: Calming things down by putting a matter off.
explanation.definitionFit: A deferment is a delay or postponement, which is what a legal stay grants.

clue.text: Beat learner driver involved in crash

indicators.note: involved in means placed within, so the learner letter goes inside

parts.note: to crash is to fail, as a computer does
L is the learner plate on a British car

explanation.surface: A novice motorist hits something during an accident.
explanation.definitionFit: To flail is to thrash or strike wildly, so to beat.

clue.text: Cunning vehicle for winter trekkers primarily

parts.note: a sleigh is a sledge drawn over snow

indicators.note: primarily means first, so only the opening letter of trekkers

explanation.surface: A clever means of transport for people crossing snowy ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight is skill in deception, as in sleight of hand, so craft or cunning.

clue.text: Fabled kingdom is lacking a capital

indicators.note: lacking means without, so the word is is taken away

parts.note: Atlantis is the legendary island kingdom that sank

explanation.surface: A legendary realm has no seat of government.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlanta is the capital city of the US state of Georgia.

clue.text: Able to grasp floating sphere with line

indicators.note: floating means drifting loose, so the letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A ball drifting with a string attached can be caught.
explanation.definitionFit: A prehensile tail or limb can curl round and hold objects.

clue.text: Race often won by such effrontery

definitions.meaning: a horse race may be won by a ..., a narrow margin

explanation.surface: Winning a race through sheer nerve.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the neck to do something means having the brazen nerve, the same as effrontery.
